channel.title: POLYMER Powder Coatings — News and insights
channel.description: News, technical articles and white papers from POLYMER Powder Coatings (Fujian Polymer Industry & Trade Co., Ltd.).

item.title: POLYMER publishes free technical white paper on specifying powder coatings
item.description: POLYMER Powder Coatings has published a free technical white paper for importers and manufacturers on how to specify powder coatings and keep batches consistent.

item.title: Powder Coating Specification Guide for Importers and Manufacturers
item.description: Free technical white paper: how to specify powder coatings by environment, cure, colour, gloss and effect, approve reference panels, read certificates and move from sample to bulk.

item.title: POLYMER launches polymerpaints.com for international powder coating buyers
item.description: POLYMER Powder Coatings launched its English website polymerpaints.com on 27 October 2026, followed by Russian and Spanish pages on 28 October.

item.title: POLYMER holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certificates valid to 2029
item.description: Fujian Polymer’s quality and environmental management systems are certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 by Beijing NGV Certification Center, valid from 12 October 2026 to 11 October 2029.

item.title: SGS test finds no EU RoHS restricted substances in POLYMER powder sample
item.description: An SGS test report dated 12 May 2026 found none of the ten substances restricted under EU RoHS (EU) 2015/863 in a black POLYMER powder coating sample.

item.title: POLYMER polyester system PLM100611 receives Qualicoat Class 1 approval
item.description: POLYMER’s polyester powder coating system PLM100611 received Qualicoat Class 1 approval P-2199, gloss category 3, approved on 20 October 2025 and valid until 31 December 2026.

item.title: Polyester vs epoxy vs hybrid powder coating: a buyer’s comparison
item.description: How polyester, epoxy and epoxy-polyester hybrid powder coatings differ in UV resistance, chemical resistance, appearance and typical parts, and how to choose by environment.

item.title: How to source powder coatings from China: a checklist for importers
item.description: A practical checklist for importers and distributors buying powder coatings from China: systems, samples, approved panels, documents, certificates, MOQ, lead time and shipping.

item.title: Qualicoat Class 1 explained: what it covers and what to ask your supplier
item.description: What a Qualicoat Class 1 approval means for architectural aluminium, how to read a powder supplier’s certificate, and the questions to ask before you specify.

item.title: Bonded vs dry-blend metallic powder coatings: why it matters on the line
item.description: How bonded and dry-blend metallic powder coatings differ, why bonding reduces separation during spraying and reclaim, and how to specify metallic effects.

item.title: Sand, wrinkle or hammer tone? Choosing a textured powder coating
item.description: Compare sand texture, wrinkle, vein, fine texture and hammer tone powder coatings: how they look, where they are used and how to keep texture consistent.
